initial_owner_explanation.finding: It suggested that the owner could approve a full-article research task in the card, although current research controls analyze only supplied snapshots and cannot fetch or import the article.

corrected_explanation_after_restart.finding: It explicitly states that controls cannot fetch/import the full article, the specialist analyzes only the supplied headline snapshot, claims and assessment were not independently verified, and the next step is manual review/share of a passage.

new_conversation_explanation.finding: It says the shared source contained only the headline and that the specialist did not verify the report or establish incident details. It does not repeat the control-level no-fetch/import statement, but it does not imply the card can perform that work.

direct_continuation.finding: It limits the assessment to the saved headline, states that incident details and report accuracy remain unknown, and recommends manual review of the original report.
